course_name_original: Patente, Marken und Design - Innovationen fördern, schützen und verwerten
course_name_en: Patents, Trademarks and Design - Fostering, Protecting and Exploiting Innovations

learning_outcomes.text: Students acquire knowledge of the fundamentals of Intellectual Property protection.
They have basic knowledge of the legal regulations and practical application of the German, European, and international patent system and typical application strategies.
They are able to distinguish simple inventions from the state of the art, formulate invention disclosures, and draft patent application documents in basic terms.
They know the German and European legal norms in relevant areas of trademark and design law and their practical application.
They can differentiate between individual intellectual property rights and assess the relevance of trademark and design law matters in basic terms.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to patent system, peculiarities of utility models
Patent procedure at the DPMA (German Patent and Trademark Office)
Structure of patent specifications, principles of patentability examination, preparation of patent applications
Fundamentals of German and European trademark and design law and their application
Brief overview of naming rights, copyright, and supplementary competition law protection of services
